description: Source code implementing XML parsing, HNAP request handling, and response generation for a network device component, including functions for XML parsing with libxml2 or expat, and handling SOAP requests and responses.

methods.name: HDK_WriteBuf
methods.description: Writes buffer data to device context, optionally without actual write.

methods.name: HDK_WriteBuf_Encode
methods.description: Encodes and writes buffer data using a specific encoding context.

methods.name: HDK_Write
methods.description: Writes a null-terminated string to device context.

methods.name: HDK_Format
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments and writes to device context.

methods.name: ElementStartHandler
methods.description: Handles start of XML element during parsing, stops parser on error.

methods.name: ElementEndHandler
methods.description: Handles end of XML element during parsing, stops parser on error.

methods.name: ElementValueHandler
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements, stops parser on error.

methods.name: HDK_Parse
methods.description: Parses XML content from device context, supports libxml2 or expat, handles errors.

methods.name: SendHNAPResponse
methods.description: Constructs and sends an HNAP SOAP response with serialized struct data.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Constructs and sends a SOAP fault message based on parse error.

methods.name: HDK_IsHNAPRequest
methods.description: Checks if the request path corresponds to an HNAP request.

methods.name: HDK_RequiresAuth
methods.description: Determines if an HNAP request requires authentication based on method and SOAP action.

methods.name: HDK_HandleRequest
methods.description: Main handler for HNAP requests; parses input, invokes method, and sends response or error.
